newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet barges trade slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet barges trade slightly firmer.

text.p: European jet fuel barges traded slightly firmer on Tuesday while cargoes in the north of the continent were discussed at easier values, traders said.
May IPE gas oil was $1.75 a tonne higher at $167.25 a tonne around 1610 GMT.
A trader said a barge volume of 4,000 tonnes changed hands at May IPE +$20.50, up around $1 from Friday's levels.

All eyes were on the result of a tender by the Erdoelbevorrattungsverband (EBV), Germany's oil stocks agency, for 250,000 tonnes of jet and 250,000 tonnes of diesel, but there was no firm word on the amount finally awarded.
Cargo offers of May IPE +$21 cif NWE failed to excite bids.
"We can't find any buying at all," one trader said.

The Mediterranean was inactive. "It looks a little long because there is a lack of buying but in fact there is muchy on offer," the trader said. European material was seen anywhere between a $6 and $10 premium to high fob Med quotes.
